description_en: Queries the number of assets that are in an abnormal state and the number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire. The assets can be elastic IP addresses (EIPs). The assets can also be Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances that are assigned public IP addresses
description_zh: 查询指定地域下，状态异常的公网IP资产的数量和即将过期的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-excpetion-count --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExcpetionCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

ExceptionIpCount.description_en: The number of assets that are in an abnormal state
ExceptionIpCount.description_zh: 受保护公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例等）中，状态异常的IP（例如，处于黑洞中等）的数量

ExpireTimeCount.description_en: The number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire
ExpireTimeCount.description_zh: 即将到期（剩余有效期不足7天）的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
